mechanisms.quote: Attacking to end the invisibility will deal %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for %backstab_duration% seconds, and cap their movement speed to %max_movement_speed%.

Attacks lower enemy movement by %cold_slow_melee%%% if they are melee and %cold_slow_ranged%%% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by %cold_attack_slow_melee%%% and Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction%%%.
The primary attack deals %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct_primary_tooltip%%% damage of a normal attack.
